summary: This is an 8-K filed by FS Bancorp, Inc. reporting its second quarter 2026 earnings and a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration of $0.29 per share. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The earnings release notes the company's proposed merger with Pacific West Bank, but the filing itself is a standard earnings and dividend announcement. No deal terms or structural changes are provided beyond the financial results and dividend information.
